verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs claim Marker "handles complex layouts, tables" and outputs Markdown/HTML. A hands-on community report concretely contradicts this: on an RPG rulebook, many tables came out messed up, and the user had to fall back to ChatGPT for irregular tables. missing for 10: documented support for merged cells, nested headers and multi-page table spans, and independent corroboration that complex tables are preserved faithfully.

support.subject: As a data engineer, complex tables — merged cells, nested headers, multi-page spans — come out as faithful HTML/markdown structure

citations.quote: Marker handles complex layouts, tables, math, and images.
